Agent Name: Clinical_Trial_Data_Analysis_Expert  
Step Number: 6  
Reason for Mistake: The Clinical_Trial_Data_Analysis_Expert provided the enrollment count of 100 participants for the clinical trial NCT03480528 without verifying whether the enrollment count specifically pertained to the time frame of Jan-May 2018. The NIH website lists the **actual enrollment count for the entire duration of the clinical trial**, not just for the specified period. The task explicitly required the enrollment count **from Jan-May 2018**, which was not addressed or validated. This oversight led to an incorrect solution to the real-world problem.
